Class Panel

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.toolkit.element.StyledElement<Panel>
dev.tamboui.toolkit.element.ContainerElement<Panel>
dev.tamboui.toolkit.elements.Panel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Styleable, Element
public final class Panel extends ContainerElement<Panel>
A container element with borders and title.

CSS properties border-type and border-color are automatically resolved through the underlying Block widget.

Layout properties can be set via CSS or programmatically:

  • direction - Layout direction: "horizontal"/"row" or "vertical"/"column"
  • flex - Flex positioning mode: "start", "center", "end", "space-between", "space-around", "space-evenly"
  • margin - Margin around the panel: single value or CSS-style shorthand
  • spacing - Gap between children in cells
  • text-align - Title alignment: "left", "center", or "right"

Programmatic values override CSS values when both are set.

      public Map<String,String> styleAttributes()
      Description copied from interface: Styleable
      Returns the style attributes for attribute selector matching.

      Attribute selectors like Panel[title="Test"] match elements based on their style attributes. This method returns a map of attribute names to their values.

      Common attributes include:

      • title - the element's title
      • label - the element's label
      • placeholder - the element's placeholder text
      Specified by:

      Overrides:
      styleAttributes in class StyledElement<Panel>
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable map of attribute names to values (never null, may be empty)

    • fit

      public Panel fit()
      Enables automatic height calculation to fit the panel's content.

      When enabled, the constraint is computed dynamically based on:

      • Border overhead: 2 rows (top and bottom borders)
      • Padding overhead: vertical padding if set
      • Children height: sum of child heights (1 row each by default, or the length from their constraint if specified)

      The height is computed when constraint() is called, so children can be added before or after calling this method.

      Overrides:
      fit in class StyledElement<Panel>
      Returns:
      this panel for chaining

    • preferredSize

      public Size preferredSize(int availableWidth, int availableHeight, RenderContext context)
      Description copied from interface: Element
      Returns the preferred size of this element.

      The availableWidth/Height parameters allow elements to adapt their dimensions based on constraints. Use -1 for unconstrained.

      Common patterns:

      • Text elements: height depends on width (text wrapping)
      • Aspect-ratio elements: both dimensions interrelated
      • Fixed elements: ignore available dimensions

      Return value semantics:

      • Positive values = known size (use as constraint)
      • Zero = explicitly zero-sized (element should collapse)
      • Negative (-1) = unknown size (element should fill available space)
      Parameters:
      availableWidth - the available width in cells, or -1 if unconstrained
      availableHeight - the available height in cells, or -1 if unconstrained
      context - the render context for CSS resolution, may be null
      Returns:
      the preferred size
